calibration.selection: Among settings passing all nine widths, minimize mean(abs(tip_travel_m / reference_length_m - 1) + max_path_deviation_m / 0.03).

metrics.success: Each of 80 waypoints reached in order at a distance strictly below 0.03 m within 3000 steps per waypoint, IK within joint limits and no simulation warnings.
metrics.tip_travel_m: Sum of Euclidean distances between consecutive 3-D tip samples used by the waypoint check at 2 ms intervals.
metrics.max_path_deviation_m: Largest over those samples of the distance to the nearest of the 16 closed reference line segments, measured in 3-D.
